messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hello! I accidentally booked a flight this morning, about 10 hours ago, and I would like to cancel it. Can you help me with that? I want to make sure I get a full refund.
Sure, I can help you with the cancellation. To proceed, I need your user ID and the reservation ID of the flight you want to cancel. Could you please provide those?
Yes, my user ID is anya_garcia_5901, and the confirmation number for the flight is 3RK2T9. As I mentioned, I booked it about 10 hours ago, so I’m hoping to get a full refund.

You booked a one-way flight from MCO to SFO with a connection in PHX for two passengers in basic economy. The booking was made about 10 hours ago, and you paid with a gift card. There is no travel insurance on this reservation.

Since the booking was made within the last 24 hours, you are eligible to cancel and get a full refund.

Please confirm if you want me to proceed with canceling this reservation.
Yes, please go ahead and cancel the reservation. I would like to receive the full refund as soon as possible. Thank you for your help!
